activities.title: Accessibility Inspector
activities.instruction: Inspect a UI and identify accessible names, keyboard focus and meaningful semantic elements.

content.concept: Improve accessibility by providing semantic structure, accessible names and usable keyboard focus.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.

descriptions: Interactive controls should have an accessible name.
Keyboard users need a visible and logical focus path.
Form controls should be associated with descriptive labels.

activities.title: ARIA Explorer
activities.instruction: Choose the appropriate accessible name or semantic solution for each UI control.

content.concept: Use semantic HTML first and understand when ARIA can provide additional accessible information.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.

choices: Use a real <button> for a button action
Use a <div> with no keyboard behavior
Hide the control from assistive technology
config.answer: Use a real <button> for a button action

activities.title: Frontend Security Explorer
activities.instruction: Choose safer handling for user input, authentication tokens and external content.

content.concept: Recognize basic frontend security practices such as avoiding unsafe HTML injection and protecting sensitive credentials.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.

choices: Keep secrets out of client-side source code
Place private API keys in public frontend code
config.answer: Keep secrets out of client-side source code

activities.title: Deployment Pipeline
activities.instruction: Arrange the main steps required to move a frontend application from source code to production.

content.concept: Understand the deployment flow from source code through testing and build configuration to a production deployment.
